scope: Keep one Dock Apps button when Launchpad opens and one Finder pin that follows the default file manager.
approval: The maintainer replied yes to publishing the paired Dock fix after receiving the Tahoe and Golden Gate previews and their coverage limits.

checks.command: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_launcher_presets.py tests/test_dock_appearance.py tests/test_dock_defaults.py tests/test_desktop_widgets.py: 173 passed on the v0.82.8-based candidate, covering both editions, both appearance modes, both launcher presets, and the retained Finder pin.
The pinned Apps visibility regression failed on v0.82.7 and passed with the fix.

Golden Gate on KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland: installed the v0.82.8-based candidate, coalesced Dolphin and Nautilus pins, opened two Dolphin windows without a second Finder task, and opened one Apps popup with the backing applet hidden.
Tahoe on the same Plasma and Wayland stack: tested the same Dock implementation staged against v0.82.7. Two Nautilus windows shared one Finder task, and opening Apps left one button and one popup.
Verified the component fingerprint ledger and checked the release diff with git diff --check.

coverage_limits: The live previews used one output on KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland. The Tahoe capture used Breeze application icons and the identical Dock implementation on v0.82.7. A VM interruption prevented recapture on the v0.82.8 baseline. The focused suite passed on the v0.82.8-based candidate. Historical galleries retain their provenance.
